text.p: Orbotech Ltd said on Thursday it has signed an agreement to acquire a controlling stake in the automated optical inspection (AOI) activity of W. Schuh GmbH of Germany.

The Israeli company will pay about six million marks ($3.3 million) and 85,209 ordinary shares of Orbotech, which are trading at $34-1/8. In addition, Orbotech has a five-year option to purchase the remaining equity.
Schuh's main product, a post-solder inspection system, was introduced in 1989. Schuh had 1996 revenues of 10 million marks.

"We believe that every assembly line should eventually have a post-solder automated inspection machine and when it comes to AOI for electronic manufacturing, we can bring this technology to market faster than anybody else," Orobotech president and chief executive Yochai Richter said in a statement.

Until automated inspection equipment became available post-solder inspection had to be performed by human inspectors. As printed circuit boards become smaller and denser, manual inspection becomes more time-consuming and inefficient.
Orbotech is the world leader in providing AOI solutions for the manufacture of printed circuit boards.
"Schuh has a proven product that has an excellent synergy with our sales and support network," said Haim Shani, vice-president for marketing and business development at Orbotech.
"With an estimated 30,000 assembly lines today and several thousand new lines every year, the industry offers a tremendous opportunity," he said.
